story.text: 동백섬 산책로는 이른 오후에도 사람이 적어 조용하다. 소나무 사이로 부는 바람에 두 사람의 손등이 '스칠' 때마다 이상하게 신경이 쓰인다.
story.reading: dong-baek-seom san-chaek-ro-neun i-reun o-hu-e-do sa-ram-i jeog-eo jo-yong-ha-da. so-na-mu sa-i-ro bu-neun ba-ram-e du sa-ram-ui son-deung-i seu-chil ttae-ma-da i-sang-ha-ge sin-gyeong-i sseu-in-da.
story.en: Dongbaekseom's walking trail is quiet even in the early afternoon, few people around. Every time the wind through the pines makes our hands brush against each other, it bothers me in a strange way.

story.text: "아까 손 스칠 때마다 니 움찔하더라? 뭐고, 내가 무슨 벌레가?" 그가 장난스레 웃지만 눈은 웃지 않는다.
story.reading: a-kka son seu-chil ttae-ma-da ni um-jjil-ha-deo-ra? mwo-go, nae-ga mu-seun beol-le-ga? geu-ga jang-nan-seu-re ut-ji-man nun-eun ut-ji an-neun-da.
story.en: "You flinched every time our hands touched just now? What, am I some kind of bug?" He laughs it off playfully, but his eyes aren't laughing.

story.text: 웃으면서 던진 말인데도 표정이 묘하게 '헷갈린다'. 장난인지 진심인지 구분이 안 될 때가 많아졌다, 요즘 들어.
story.reading: us-eu-myeon-seo deon-jin mal-in-de-do pyo-jeong-i myo-ha-ge het-gal-lin-da. jang-nan-in-ji jin-sim-in-ji gu-bun-i an doel ttae-ga man-a-jyeot-da, yo-jeum deul-eo.
story.en: Even though he says it with a laugh, his expression is oddly confusing. Lately it's become harder and harder to tell whether he's joking or serious.

story.text: "우리 사이에 무슨 '경계' 같은 게 있었나. 소꿉친구, 그거 하나로 딱 정해져 있었는데, 요즘은 그 선이 자꾸 흐릿해진다."
story.reading: u-ri sa-i-e mu-seun gyeong-gye gat-eun ge iss-eon-na. so-kkup-chin-gu, geu-geo ha-na-ro ttak jeong-hae-jyeo it-eot-neun-de, yo-jeum-eun geu seon-i ja-kku heu-rit-hae-jin-da.
story.en: "Was there ever some kind of line between us? Childhood friends — that was the one clear label. But lately that line keeps getting blurry."

story.text: 그가 잠시 걸음을 멈추고 나를 빤히 바라본다. "이거 내 '착각'인가 싶다가도… 아니다 싶고. 니는 어떻노, 니도 그런 느낌 있나?"
story.reading: geu-ga jam-si geol-eum-eul meom-chu-go na-reul ppan-hi ba-ra-bon-da. i-geo nae chak-gak-in-ga sip-da-ga-do… a-ni-da sip-go. ni-neun eo-tteon-no, ni-do geu-reon neu-kkim it-na?
story.en: He stops walking for a moment and stares straight at me. "I keep thinking maybe this is just me imagining things… then thinking, no, it's not. What about you, do you get that feeling too?"

story.text: "…아니다! 방금 그거 그냥 물어본 거다, 신경 쓰지 마라! 우리 친구잖아, 친구끼리 이런 거 물어볼 수도 있제, 안 그렇나?"
story.reading: …a-ni-da! bang-geum geu-geo geu-nyang mul-eo-bon geo-da, sin-gyeong sseu-ji ma-ra! u-ri chin-gu-jan-a, chin-gu-kki-ri i-reon geo mul-eo-bol su-do it-je, an geu-reon-na?
story.en: "…No, never mind! I just asked that randomly, don't read into it! We're friends, right — friends can ask stuff like that too, can't they?"

story.text: "아 몰라, 갑자기 '새삼' 이상한 기분 든다. 밥이나 무러 가자, 배고프다 내가!"
story.reading: a mol-la, gap-ja-gi sae-sam i-sang-han gi-bun deun-da. bap-i-na mu-reo ga-ja, bae-go-peu-da nae-ga!
story.en: "Ugh, I don't know, suddenly this weird feeling's hitting me all over again. Let's go eat, I'm starving!"

story.text: "단어는 다 봤제? 이번 대화 문제도 잘 읽고 풀어봐라."
story.reading: dan-eo-neun da bwat-je? i-beon dae-hwa mun-je-do jal ilg-go pul-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: "Got a look at all the words? Read this conversation question carefully and give it a try."

words.example_en: Our shoulders brushed as we passed by.

words.example: 그의 마음을 도무지 알 수가 없어 헷갈렸다.
words.example_reading: geu-ui ma-eum-eul do-mu-ji al su-ga eop-seo het-gal-lyeot-da
words.example_en: I had no idea what he was really thinking, it confused me.
The line between friends and lovers had blurred.
I wondered if that had just been my own delusion.
I was struck anew by how kind he was.

sentences.en: Passing through the crowded street, our shoulders brushed.
I was confused about what his true feelings were.
The boundary between friend and lover gradually blurred.

sentences.ko: 그게 내 착각인 줄 알았는데 아니었다.
sentences.reading: geu-ge nae chak-gak-in jul al-at-neun-de a-ni-eot-da
sentences.en: I thought it was just my own imagination, but it wasn't.
His thoughtfulness warmed my heart anew.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 요즘 니랑 있으면 그냥 옛날처럼 편하지가 않다. 이상하제?
turns.reading: yo-jeum ni-rang it-eu-myeon geu-nyang yen-nal-cheo-reom pyeon-ha-ji-ga an-ta. i-sang-ha-je?
turns.en: Lately, being with you doesn't feel as easy and comfortable as it used to. Weird, right?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 나도 그래. 예전엔 안 그랬는데, 요즘은 좀… 뭐라 해야 되지.
turns.reading: na-do geu-rae. ye-jeon-en an geu-raet-neun-de, yo-jeum-eun jom… mwo-ra hae-ya doe-ji.
turns.en: Me too. It wasn't like this before, but these days it's kind of… how do I put it.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 거봐라, 니도 그렇제? 이거 무슨 조짐인지 모르겠다.
turns.reading: geo-bwa-ra, ni-do geu-ron-je? i-geo mu-seun jo-jim-in-ji mo-reu-get-da.
turns.en: See, you feel it too, right? I don't know what kind of sign this is.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 조짐은 무슨. 그냥 오랜만에 만나서 그런 거 아니야?
turns.reading: jo-jim-eun mu-seun. geu-nyang o-raen-man-e man-na-seo geu-reon geo a-ni-ya?
turns.en: What sign. Isn't it just because we haven't seen each other in a while?

dialogues.question: 선우와 승객이 공통으로 느끼는 감정은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What feeling do Sunwoo and the passenger share in common?
dialogues.correct_answer: 예전과 달리 서로 사이가 어색하고 편하지 않게 느껴진다
options: 예전과 달리 서로 사이가 어색하고 편하지 않게 느껴진다
둘 다 빨리 헤어지고 싶어 한다
둘 다 날씨 때문에 짜증이 나 있다
dialogues.explanation: 두 사람 모두 예전과 달리 서로가 편하지 않고 무언가 달라졌다는 것을 느끼며 어색해하고 있습니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 아이다, 오랜만이라서가 아니고. 이게… 뭐라캐야 되노, 이.
turns.reading: a-i-da, o-raen-man-i-ra-seo-ga a-ni-go. i-ge… mwo-ra-kae-ya doe-no, i.
turns.en: No, it's not because it's been a while. This is… how do I even put this.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Just say it, what is it.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 됐다! 아이다! 그냥 배고파서 그렇다, 배고파서! 밥이나 무러 가자!
turns.reading: dwaet-da! a-i-da! geu-nyang bae-go-pa-seo geu-ro-ta, bae-go-pa-seo! bap-i-na mu-reo ga-ja!
turns.en: Forget it! Never mind! It's just because I'm hungry, hungry! Let's go eat!

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 지금 완전 도망가는 거 다 티 난다.
turns.reading: ji-geum wan-jeon do-mang-ga-neun geo da ti na-da.
turns.en: It's totally obvious you're running away right now.

dialogues.question: 선우가 말을 끝맺지 못하고 화제를 돌린 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why does Sunwoo fail to finish his sentence and change the subject?
dialogues.correct_answer: 자신의 감정을 뭐라고 설명해야 할지 몰라 당황했기 때문에
options: 자신의 감정을 뭐라고 설명해야 할지 몰라 당황했기 때문에
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 자신의 흔들리는 감정을 어떻게 표현해야 할지 몰라 당황한 나머지, 배고프다는 핑계로 급히 화제를 돌립니다.
